why: «стволик» is only ever used of a young tree or shrub trunk, so «стволик травянистого растения» contradicts itself; the gloss and all three examples (celery, corn, a field) are herbaceous, where Russian says only «стебель»

gloss defines the decorative knot with two loops, not the strip of cloth; «лента» is the ribbon a bow is tied from and is already the gloss of the separate headword ribbon, so listing it here teaches bow = ribbon

gloss defines the brief snowfall event, but «снежные хлопья» names the flakes themselves; the examples are all about the event ("expecting flurries tonight", "nothing stuck"), and «кратковременный снег» is the standard Russian forecast term
